# Little World School, Ambivli

> Quality English-medium co-educational school from Playgroup to Grade 12 in Ambivli (West), Kalyan, Thane, Maharashtra, India. Admissions open for Playgroup, Nursery, Junior KG, Senior KG, and Grades 1 through 12.

## Key Information
- Official Website: https://little-world-school.vercel.app/
- Official Admissions WhatsApp: +91 8652681370 (https://wa.me/918652681370)
- Location: Neptune Swarajya, Swarajya Road, Village Ambivli (West), Taluka Kalyan, District Thane, Maharashtra 421102, India
- Landmark: Near Ambivli Railway Station (Central Line, ~5 min walk / auto)
- Curriculum: English medium curriculum with multilingual Marathi & Hindi pastoral support
- Operating Hours: Monday – Saturday, 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM IST

## Academic Programs
- Playgroup (Age 1.8 - 2.5 years): Early sensory play, motor skill exploration, interactive storytelling
- Nursery (Age 2.5 - 3.5 years): Foundational phonics, creative arts, social development, cognitive routines
- Junior KG (Age 3.5 - 4.5 years): Early literacy, numeric reasoning, experiential STEM play
- Senior KG (Age 4.5 - 5.5 years): Reading comprehension, elementary math, curiosity projects, school readiness
- Grade 1 to Grade 12: Comprehensive CBSE/State-aligned primary, middle, secondary, and senior secondary education with science, commerce, computer lab, sports, and life skills

## Campus Facilities
- Safe, gated campus within Neptune Swarajya township
- High-definition CCTV surveillance across all classrooms and learning zones
- Child-safe ergonomic furniture, indoor activity zones, and outdoor play space
- Dedicated female attendant support and hygiene protocols
- Emergency first-aid kit and on-call medical assistance
